question: What effect is attributed to the visualization with the splendor of molten gold?
premises: A form with the splendor of molten gold is described.
It is said to be a cause of agitation of cities and so forth.
The description links color and effect.
inference: The molten-gold visualization causes the agitation of cities and similar effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of agitating cities and the like.
